home.setupWorkspaceDesc: Point at a project folder on this Mac
home.welcomeSubtitle: Three quick steps and your contacts can put coding agents to work on this Mac.

issues.emptyDescription: Issues appear here once your agents start working on routed messages.
issues.title: Issues

onboarding.slide1Body: CODM connects WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram to coding agents running on this Mac — DM your codebase like it's any DM platform. Open source, no account, everything stays local.
onboarding.slide3Body: Agents pause on server errors, blocked replies, or when someone asks for a human. You review, steer with a whisper, or take over — nothing ships without your say.
onboarding.stepThreadDesc: Bind a contact or group to a folder and pick the agents
onboarding.stepWorkspaceDesc: Point at a project folder — Claude projects are detected

systemPreconditions.slideBody: CODM needs this before it can do any work on this Mac.
systemPreconditions.noAppIdentity: In this build CODM runs without an identity of its own, so the permission does not belong to it — it belongs to the terminal you launched it from. Grant access to that terminal in Settings and restart it.

fullDiskAccess.title: Full Disk Access
fullDiskAccess.body: Agents read your project folders through CODM — as far as macOS is concerned, the app is the reader. Without this permission the system blocks those reads and tasks stop with no explanation.
fullDiskAccess.actionHint: Two steps, in this order: CODM clears the denial already on record, then opens Privacy & Security › Full Disk Access, where you switch CODM on.
fullDiskAccess.afterHint: Come back to this window after granting — the check runs again on its own.

session.agentModelRestartHint: Switching the model restarts the conversation on the agent: it comes back without the context it had, from the next message on.
session.artifactsEmptyDescription: Preview deploys, screenshots and files produced by your agents land here.
session.autonomyPaused: Paused — won't reply until you resume it
session.boundAgentsComingSoonHint: This conversation is bound to an agent this build can't drive yet, so it won't reply. Delete it and re-attach the contact to an available agent.
session.chatEmptyDescription: Messages from this contact and your agents will appear here.
session.composerDirectHint: Direct replies are sent to the channel as you.
session.composerPlaceholderSteer: Whisper a steer to the agents…
session.composerSteerHint: Whispers reach agents only — never sent to the channel.
session.contextBufferHint: Every message is kept in a rolling buffer the agents can read — including from people who can't invoke.
session.customPromptHint: Your own instructions for this conversation. They go into the agent's prompt on every message and outrank the built-in defaults — except rewriting git history and installing dependencies, which stay off-limits.
session.customPromptPlaceholder: e.g. always reply in English to this client. Never promise a deadline.

deleteThread.confirmDescription: The conversation with {{name}} disappears from the list, the dashboard and the chat, and new messages from that contact are ignored. The history is kept — re-attaching from the wizard brings it all back.
deleteThread.hint: Deleting removes this conversation from the console. The history is kept, and you can re-attach the contact from the wizard later.

session.issuesEmptyDescription: Routed messages that spawn work will show up here as issues.

loops.deleteConfirmDescription: This scheduled prompt stops being sent. Whatever it already whispered stays in the conversation history.
loops.emptyDescription: A loop is a prompt CODM whispers into this conversation on its own — at a fixed time on the days you choose, or every so many minutes.
loops.hint: Prompts that repeat on their own in this conversation. Each run arrives as a whisper — only the agents read it, never the contact.
loops.promptPlaceholder: e.g. ask the team how today's deploy is going and summarise it in three lines.

session.onlyWhenMentionedHint: Otherwise agents respond to every message in the thread.
session.settingsDescription: Tune how agents behave in this thread.
session.steerHint: Steers reach the agent working this issue only.

settings.telemetryConsentDescription: Anonymous usage analytics — page views and clicks in this console. Off stops every request immediately.
